product.olivetti-snx-460-rs.summary: The tower Pentium Pro Systema with room for four processors.
product.olivetti-snx-460-rs.history: Olivetti announced the SNX 460 in December 1995 as its first Pentium Pro server and confirmed that the processor board used an Intel design. Computerwoche reported first-quarter 1996 shipments from about DM 20,000.
product.olivetti-snx-460-rs.architecture: Work could be shared across four processors. The Intel Orion chipset connects two CPU cards, with two Pentium Pro chips per card, and two PCI buses.
product.olivetti-snx-460-rs.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-460-rs.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-460-rs.service-guid: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 4
product.olivetti-snx-460-rs.computerwoch: Computerwoche, Olivetti-Server mit Pentium Pro nutzen Platinendesign von Intel, 22 December 1995
